theFirstCertificateRequestMayTake: The first certificate request may take a few minutes. Setup finishes only after both HTTPS and service checks complete.
theOsDockerUsersAndDisk: The OS, Docker, users and disk layout stay as they are. Normal setup preserves secrets, administrators, storage paths, the public URL and HTTPS. Set the processing time to 840 seconds or less to fit the service shutdown grace period.
theStartThresholdChecksAvailableRam: The start threshold checks available RAM. During execution, RAM is used as needed up to its limit. Additional swap uses existing swap space. Set it to 0 to disable it. 1 GiB = 1024 MiB.
